patch_script = '''import sys, json, os
os.environ["LOGURU_LEVEL"] = "ERROR"
sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

# Connect to world.db directly
db_path = Path("/workspace/world.db")
conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_path))
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

SOURCE_SKILL = "tau2Airline"
_TAU2_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy", "premium_economy"}
_TAU2_STATUSES = {"available", "landed", "cancelled", "delayed", "flying", "on time"}
_TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES = {"one_way", "round_trip"}

# Build flights dict with sanitization
flights = {}
for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM flights WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)):
    dates_raw = json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}")
    clean_dates = {}
    for d, info in dates_raw.items():
        # Fix status: map unknown statuses to 'available'
        status = info.get("status", "available")
        if status not in _TAU2_STATUSES:
            status = "available"
            info["status"] = status
        # Fix prices: remove unknown cabin keys
        if "prices" in info:
            info["prices"] = {k: v for k, v in info["prices"].items() if k in _TAU2_CABINS}
        if "available_seats" in info:
            info["available_seats"] = {k: v for k, v in info["available_seats"].items() if k in _TAU2_CABINS}
        clean_dates[d] = info

    flights[r["flight_id"]] = {
        "flight_number": r["flight_id"],
        "origin": r["origin"],
        "destination": r["destination"],
        "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"] or "00:00:00",
        "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"] or "00:00:00",
        "dates": clean_dates,
    }

# Build reservations
resv_by_user = {}
reservations = {}
for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)):
    res_flights = []
    for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):
        res_flights.append({
            "flight_number": fj.get("flight_number") or fj.get("flight_id"),
            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),
            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),
            "date": fj.get("date", ""),
            "price": fj.get("price", 0),
        })
    # Fix passengers: ensure dob exists
    passengers = json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]")
    for p in passengers:
        if "dob" not in p:
            p["dob"] = p.get("date_of_birth", "1990-01-01")
    
    cabin = r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy"
    ft = r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way"
    
    reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {
        "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],
        "user_id": r["user_id"],
        "origin": r["origin"],
        "destination": r["destination"],
        "flight_type": ft,
        "cabin": cabin,
        "flights": res_flights,
        "passengers": passengers,
        "payment_history": json.loads(r["payment_history_json"] or "[]"),
        "created_at": r["booked_at"],
        "total_baggages": r["total_baggages"],
        "nonfree_baggages": r["nonfree_baggages"],
        "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",
        "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,
    }
    resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])

# Build users
_TIER_MAP = {"standard": "regular"}
users = {}
for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?", (f'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%',)):
    users[r["user_id"]] = {
        "user_id": r["user_id"],
        "name": {"first_name": (r["name"] or "").split(" ", 1)[0], "last_name": (r["name"] or "").split(" ", 1)[1] if " " in (r["name"] or "") else ""},
        "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),
        "email": r["email"],
        "dob": r["dob"] or "",
        "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),
        "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),
        "membership": _TIER_MAP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),
        "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),
    }
conn.close()

# Now validate
from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
db = FlightDB.model_validate({"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations})
print(f"SUCCESS: {len(db.flights)} flights, {len(db.users)} users, {len(db.reservations)} reservations")

# Search for LAX->SFO on 2026-09-10
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools
tools = AirlineTools(db)
result = tools.search_direct_flight("LAX", "SFO", "2026-09-10")
print("FLIGHT_SEARCH:", result)

# List users
for uid in db.users:
    u = db.users[uid]
    pm_types = [v.source for v in u.payment_methods.values()]
    print(f"USER: {uid} | {u.name.first_name} {u.name.last_name} | membership={u.membership} | payment_types={pm_types}")
'''
await write_file("./fix_load.py", patch_script)
print("Script written")

# Print the full output
print(fix_out)
